detailed_descriptions.en: Located in the south-central region of the United States, the state is a nature wonderland with three national forests, many State Parks, nearly 9,000 miles of pristine streams and rivers like the Arkansas and Mississippi, as well as the ever-stretching Ozark and Ouachita mountain ranges. While hauling cargo, you will be able to not only see some of these beautiful landscapes and areas, but travel through a variety of large and small towns and cities, where you'll find industries, landmarks and more. Take your time and enjoy every moment as you discover: 10 explorable cities including Little Rock, Fortsmith, Fayetteville and Pine Bluff. See several landmarks unique to Arkansas such as the historical centre of Hot Springs with its Bathhouse Row and National Park, iconic art murals, the majestic Arlington Hotel, courthouses, churches and more. Enjoy trucking through 10 scenic towns (settlements) Discover a variety of different viewpoints across Arkansas See the famous Arkansas and Mississippi rivers which run through the State. Drive across the impressively large Emmitt Sanders Lock and Dam, which has been in operation since December 1968! Deliver to unique industries such as the Nuclear One power plant, and custom built River Port & Timber Harvest depots. Experience the new dynamic loading and unloading of logs onto your trailer. Discover the hidden treasures of Arkansas's countryside, forest, swampland, viewpoints, road network and more.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Located in the south-central region of the United States, the state is a nature wonderland with three national forests, many State Parks, nearly 9,000 miles of pristine streams and rivers like the Arkansas and Mississippi, as well as the ever-stretching Ozark and Ouachita mountain ranges.

While hauling cargo, you will be able to not only see some of these beautiful landscapes and areas, but travel through a variety of large and small towns and cities, where you'll find industries, landmarks and more.

Take your time and enjoy every moment as you discover:

  • 10 explorable cities including Little Rock, Fortsmith, Fayetteville and Pine Bluff.
  • See several landmarks unique to Arkansas such as the historical centre of Hot Springs with its Bathhouse Row and National Park, iconic art murals, the majestic Arlington Hotel, courthouses, churches and more.
  • Enjoy trucking through 10 scenic towns (settlements)
  • Discover a variety of different viewpoints across Arkansas
  • See the famous Arkansas and Mississippi rivers which run through the State.
  • Drive across the impressively large Emmitt Sanders Lock and Dam, which has been in operation since December 1968!
  • Deliver to unique industries such as the Nuclear One power plant, and custom built River Port & Timber Harvest depots.
  • Experience the new dynamic loading and unloading of logs onto your trailer.
  • Discover the hidden treasures of Arkansas's countryside, forest, swampland, viewpoints, road network and more.
